Schwartz will join First National Corporation and First Bank as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) effective March 31, 2025. Brad brings over 40 years of experience in banking in Virginia and is retired President and COO of TowneBank and formerly CEO, CFO, and COO of Monarch Bank prior to its acquisition by TowneBank.
